subject: Obtain a match between histogram and density estimate

messages.author: 240605e088db79ab
messages.subject: Obtain a match between histogram and density estimate
parts:
Hello ggplotters',


In the graph below of a histogram and overlaid density estimate, I am wondering how do I ensure that the tails of the density match the extent of the lowest and highest bars of the histogram.

Any help or suggestions are greatly appreciated.

Thanks,

Art

# Example data set

ex_data1 <- rnorm(100, mean = 60, sd = 8)
ex_data2 <- rnorm(100, mean = 60, sd = 8)
ex_data <- data.frame(ex_data1, ex_data2)

library(ggplot2)

# Graph

ex_graph <- ggplot(ex_data, aes(ex_data1)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 8, aes(y = ..density.., fill = ..density..)) +
    scale_fill_gradient("Density", low = "green", high = "red") +
    geom_density(colour="black", size=1, fill="grey", alpha = 0.5)

print(ex_graph)
